instruction: Look at hard-19_seed.dxf. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'calibration plate with nonuniform hole schedule' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (12,0)->(268,0); OUTLINE (280,12)->(280,148); OUTLINE (268,160)->(12,160); OUTLINE (0,148)->(0,12); CENTER (0,0)->(280,160); CENTER (0,160)->(280,0); CENTER (140,0)->(140,160); CENTER (0,80)->(280,80); CUTOUT (50,59)->(90,59); CUTOUT (50,51)->(90,51); CUTOUT (190,109)->(230,109); CUTOUT (190,101)->(230,101); CUTOUT (135,55)->(135,105); CUTOUT (145,55)->(145,105). Required circles: HOLE center (30,30) radius 3; HOLE center (70,30) radius 4; HOLE center (120,30) radius 5; HOLE center (180,30) radius 6; HOLE center (240,30) radius 7; HOLE center (45,80) radius 4; HOLE center (95,80) radius 5; HOLE center (145,80) radius 6; HOLE center (195,80) radius 5; HOLE center (245,80) radius 4; HOLE center (30,130) radius 7; HOLE center (85,130) radius 6; HOLE center (140,130) radius 5; HOLE center (195,130) radius 4; HOLE center (250,130) radius 3. Required arcs: OUTLINE center (12,12) radius 12 start 180 end 270; OUTLINE center (268,12) radius 12 start 270 end 0; OUTLINE center (268,148) radius 12 start 0 end 90; OUTLINE center (12,148) radius 12 start 90 end 180; CUTOUT center (50,55) radius 4 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (90,55) radius 4 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (190,105) radius 4 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (230,105) radius 4 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (140,105) radius 5 start 0 end 180; CUTOUT center (140,55) radius 5 start 180 end 0. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H19; ANNOTATION text CAL PLATE REV C; ANNOTATION text NONUNIFORM HOLES. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
